svg.title: Galadriel question-first method-selection decision map
svg.desc: A five-lane decision map for the proposed Galadriel 0.9 profile. Residual magnitude selects right-tail normalized innovation squared plus a tabular two-arm CUSUM. The lower arm is inert on the fusion core's degrees-of-freedom-three route. Other admitted degrees of freedom retain the general recurrence. Positive linear association selects signed Pearson correlation, one-sided Fisher-z screening, per-assessment Bonferroni correction, and a unique largest all-pairs clique that is a strict majority. General continuous pair dependence selects report-first KSG-1 only as a geometry-, support-, resource-, and stability-gated companion. The full stability route needs at least 72 admitted rows and deletes every circular block of eight. Target information allocation selects categorical MGW for an atomic law or the feature-gated experimental Ehrlich PID2 route for an eligible continuous law. An explicit authority firewall prevents every mutual-information or PID result from changing a verdict, grant, restriction, trusted state, or plant command. Each lane names alternatives and its evidence ceiling. The decision record remains proposed and awaits human acceptance and publication review.
svg.text: GALADRIEL · PROPOSED 0.9 METHOD AND PROFILE DECISIONS
Start with the question. Preserve the estimand. Stop before authority.
Least-complex selected object → separate expressive companion → explicit non-edge
